# routeros_partitions (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the partition, for example `part0`. The partition has to exist already; it is looked up by this name.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___skip___` (String) <em>A set of transformations for field names. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `comment` (String)
- `fallback_to` (String) The partition that is booted if this one fails to boot: the name of another partition, `next` for the next partition in order, or `etherboot` to fall back to network boot.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the partition is the one that is booted by default.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `running` (Boolean)
- `size` (String) The size of the partition, in MiB.
- `version` (String) The RouterOS version installed on the partition.
